issues.legal_issue: A suit for specific performance of the entire property cannot be decreed where the sale agreement was executed by only one co-owner without proof of authority to bind the other co-owners.

In a suit for specific performance, a power-of-attorney holder cannot testify in place of the plaintiff about the plaintiff’s personal knowledge, state of mind, or readiness and willingness to perform the contract.
Specific performance may be denied where the plaintiff delays filing suit until the end of the limitation period despite knowing of the breach and the agreement’s stipulated time limits.
